tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Pale mint page behind every stack of blocks. Flat: no gradients, no lights.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White blocks, cards, lists, plates and badges.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Light grey ground for things that sit lower: recipe rows, mood buttons, goal rows, stat tiles, chips, soft buttons, fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row separators, the tab bar's hairline ring.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Unchecked circles, outline buttons, empty days, the switch when off. Decorative only.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons, and the black of every primary action (capsule buttons, the + in the bar, selected states). 18.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, row descriptions, captions. 5.9:1 on white, 5.2:1 on sunken.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Inactive tab icons, chevrons, placeholders. 2.8:1: never for reading.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on black only.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Pink marks the current thing: today’s tick, the current arc segment, the streak star. Text on it is text.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Pink as text: links, small accents, the receipt percentage. 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft pink grounds: tiles, the receipt's favourite strip, the result plate.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: The pink colour light behind screens, badge gradients.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Mint fill for the one emphasised block per group (weekly goal, bake metrics), the selected dock tab, done arc segments. Text on it is text (11.7:1).

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Soft mint grounds: tiles, feed cards, item art.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Break segments, the outlined script word.

tokens.name: mint-strong
tokens.usage: Mint as text, if ever needed.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Live dots and ticks. Text on it is text.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: The live “12 baking” label. 5.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Lemon, kept for the pour line only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive alert actions.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and alerts.

tokens.name: pink-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour only.

tokens.name: sky-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour only.

tokens.name: mint-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour only.

tokens.name: lemon-l
tokens.usage: Illustration and data colour only.

tokens.name: caramel
tokens.usage: Illustration only: wood, crusts, oven feet.

tokens.name: pink-plate
tokens.usage: Pink tint under plates, badges and the baking flower.

tokens.name: mint-plate
tokens.usage: Pale mint for the greeting flower and the lock pill.

families.sans: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The Home wordmark, result verdicts, report titles. May end in a pink asterisk.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Little Bear is waiting for it

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Black label chips, block labels, tags.

styles.name: tiny
styles.usage: Mono uppercase decoration: “PICK A MOOD”, receipt footers. Never the only label for something.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Running countdowns, tabular figures. During a break or pause it turns into an outline.

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Inside a label group.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, mood buttons, list cards.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Icon to text; blocks; section header to content.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; row side padding.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter; hero card padding.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Rare large separations.

tokens.name: r-block
tokens.usage: Every block, card and list.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Mono pills.

tokens.name: r-sq
tokens.usage: The small square START button.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Dock, segmented pill, PAUSE/END, round buttons, badges.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass cards: a lit top edge and a faint pink drop.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating chrome: the tab bar and banners.

tokens.name: jelly
tokens.usage: Dessert illustrations: a pink glow underneath so the flat art reads as glossy.

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.value: drop-shadow(±2px white outline) + drop-shadow(2px 3px 0 #111113) + drop-shadow(0 10px 10px rgba(17,17,19,.18))
tokens.usage: Die-cut stickers: category icons and feed desserts get a white outline, a crisp black offset and a soft drop.

tokens.name: h-l
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and fields; the hero button is 60 with a 48 round arrow.

tokens.name: h-m
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, mood buttons.

tokens.name: h-s
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, chips.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Arrivals, screen pushes, meters filling.

tokens.name: spring
tokens.usage: Presses (scale .96), selections, toasts, badges stamping on.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Space between stacked blocks.

tokens.name: neck
tokens.value: 30 × 21px, 26px in from each side, 8px concave cut
tokens.usage: Fuses a block to the one above (.blk.join); a sideways neck joins a .pair.

tokens.name: stack-inset
tokens.usage: Stacks sit 12px from the screen edges.

tokens.name: flower6 / flower8 / flower12
tokens.usage: Break steps, frames, the greeting flower, the baking flower.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Badges and frames.

tokens.name: scallop
tokens.usage: Plates and bake steps.

tokens.name: ticks
tokens.usage: Weekly goal: done black, today pink, rest grey.

tokens.name: arc-half
tokens.usage: Focus today.

tokens.name: arc-ring
tokens.usage: Baking progress: done mint, current pink, rest grey.
